title: Force Directed Graph
description: Interactive simulation for Force Directed Graph
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Force
learningObjectives: Identify the two competing forces in the layout algorithm: repulsion between every pair of vertices and spring attraction along each edge
Trace how stepping the algorithm 1, 10, 100, and 1,000 iterations moves 20 randomly placed vertices toward an equilibrium layout
Explain why the reported total vertex movement per step decreases as the graph converges
Predict how changing repulsive force, spring length, or spring strength alters the final spacing between connected vertices
Evaluate the resulting layout for edge crossings and cluster separation as a measure of readability
